name: Stored Value Data 9
definition: Data related to the stored value card.

Provider.name: Provider
Provider.definition: Identification of the provider of the stored value account load/reload.

TransactionType.name: Transaction Type
TransactionType.definition: Identification of operation to proceed on the stored value account or the stored value card.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Identification of the stored value account or the stored value card.

OriginalPOITransaction.name: Original POI Transaction
OriginalPOITransaction.definition: Identification of a previous POI transaction.

ProductCode.name: Product Code
ProductCode.definition: Product code of item purchased with the transaction.

EANUPC.name: EANUPC
EANUPC.definition: Standard European Article Number Universal Product Code of item purchased with the transaction.

ItemAmount.name: Item Amount
ItemAmount.definition: Total amount of the item line.

HostTransactionIdentification.name: Host Transaction Identification
HostTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction by the host in charge of the stored value transaction.
